name: feature-spec
description: Turns what you already have — a brief, a document, an idea — into a critic-verified spec, asking only about what is still unclear, then turns that spec into a checked implementation plan. Coverage-tracked intake, strategy selection, glossary and ADRs, tasks joined to requirements in both directions.
